page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-224 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the m4n server family. It features 224 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 2976.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a high memory-to-core ratio of approximately 13.29 GB of RAM per vCPU, positioning the instance for workloads requiring massive memory footprints.

The hardware configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance. Given the high density of dedicated vCPUs and memory resources, this server represents a high-tier hardware profile designed for resource-intensive enterprise applications where memory capacity is the primary bottleneck.

This server is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data-processing workloads that operate entirely within system memory. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration makes it less suitable for local-storage-heavy database configurations or parallelized graphics and machine learning training tasks, focusing its utility strictly on memory-bound enterprise computing.
